# oncallalert_escalation_policy (Data Source)

Looks up a escalation policy by exact name (case-insensitive).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oncallalert_escalation_policy" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
